requirements.text: At least three years of experience in quantitative advisory projects.
Master’s or higher degree in economics, statistics, mathematics, applied mathematics, or computer science (Bachelor’s with relevant coursework acceptable).
Proficiency in data analysis software such as STATA, SAS, Python, SQL, or R.
Experience managing large data sets, financial and statistical analysis, and building economic or mathematical models.
Knowledge of data science, machine learning, and LLM-based solutions.
Strong creative thinking, problem-solving, and excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
Authorized to work without sponsorship in the U.S.

This position involves conducting statistical, economic, and financial analysis on various policy, regulatory, and business issues for diverse clients. You will develop and apply complex algorithms, enhance mathematical models, manipulate large data sets, and create insightful reports accessible to both technical and non-technical audiences. Collaboration within a team and maintaining professional integrity are essential.
Uphold a respectful and ethical work environment with professionalism and responsibility.
